profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cosairus
profile.summary:
Extensive knowledge in Testing, Software Development, system analysis and design, and technical leadership. Proven ability to work with all levels of management as well as team members to develop solutions to technical issues that can be leveraged by any organization. Solid reputation for quality results and meeting goals on time and within budget without sacrificing customer satisfaction or quality.

Full-stack software engineer responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing enterprise applications across frontend, backend, and database layers. Work within an Agile development environment, leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development efficiency, solution design, and software quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
- Develop and maintain full-stack enterprise applications, including frontend user interfaces, backend APIs, and database components.
- Design and implement application enhancements, defect resolutions, and new functionality based on business requirements and technical specifications.
- Leverage Claude AI and Azure DevOps to support specification-driven software development, including requirements analysis, codebase investigation, solution design, implementation planning, and test planning.
- Utilize AI-assisted development workflows to analyze application requirements and defects, evaluate proposed technical solutions, and implement approved changes across the application codebase.
- Review and validate AI-generated implementations, ensuring alignment with existing application architecture, business rules, functionality, and technical requirements.
- Participate in collaborative pull request reviews, working with fellow developers to maintain code quality, consistency, and application reliability.
- Develop and execute application tests and assist with defect investigation and resolution throughout the software development lifecycle.
- Support structured release processes involving development, QA, staging, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) environments.
- Develop and maintain database functionality using Entity Framework, SQL, and stored procedures.
- Collaborate with development teams and business stakeholders to deliver application enhancements and resolve complex technical issues.

positions.title: QA Tester, Consultant
positions.description:
- Development and design of test plans specific for different computer software programs
- Receiving, interpretation and documentation of error reports from the users
- Collaborate with Project Manager for the development of Use Cases and software test plans
- Creation and design of test scenarios for the testing of software programs
- Keeping up to date with standards and requirements of software quality assurance and ensuring its applicability is incorporated into future test plans and Use Cases
- Development and implementation of software program functionality tests
- Development and implementation of software program regression tests
- Preparation of reports on defects and problems that arise during software tests
- Tracking of reported problems and defects using tracking software

positions.title: LookUp R&D Manager
positions.description:
Developed detailed project plans including major enhancements and critical bug fixes. Provided development and QA time estimates. Maintained product reports. Tracked individual item status.
•	Created comprehensive project requirements for product development; included prioritization of each item and timelines.
•	Orchestrated all phases of development of 5 products, coordinating outsourced development and QA teams located in the Ukraine.
•	Directed development of unique Blackberry product through to completion, sale, and installation.  
•	Maintained continuous development of outsourced projects, despite major reduction in development and QA resources, reengineering project and development plans, and personally conducting QA.

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
Formulated and executed test plans, strategies, cases, suites, scenarios, and scripts. Performed functional, system, performance, regression, and acceptance testing. Tracked and documented defects, bugs, and requirements throughout development lifecycle. Developed and administered AQDevTeam projects, macros, workflows, users, and permissions.
•	Designed 1,000s of clear and concise manual test cases for diverse software projects.
•	Saved significant time and labor costs, automating web product to create 20 test cases.
•	Completed all projects within uniquely specified deadlines, strategically prioritizing work load. 
•	Improved quality of testing while reducing number of test cases, restructuring test plan.

positions.title: Support Specialist
positions.description:
• Keeps customer teams informed/involved in product related issues
• Analyzes incoming user questions and issues. 
• Troubleshoots and resolves customer issues including workarounds, suggestions, alternative usage, fixes, test cases, etc. 
• Maintain excellent customer relations
• Restore data with clients.
• Recover data with clients.
